source_message.text: Because RFP timelines tend to compress at the end, I expect the turnaround for this work to be last-minute, although I suspect the RFP itself will be released next quarter. Nadia, I’m seeking layout and design support for the resulting response (proposal), which will need to follow strict rules for file size, page numbers, and similar details. 1) Have you supported this type of proposal before? 2) If so, how do you prepare with clients for these timelines, particularly when client edits may continue until the proposal is final?
